heading: Annual report to Congress by Federal Surplus Commodities Corporation
lead: The Federal Surplus Commodities Corporation shall submit to Congress on the first day of each regular session an annual report setting forth a statement of the activities, receipts, and expenditures of the Corporation during the previous year.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was previously classified to section 1293 of Title 7, Agriculture.

notes.heading: Transfer of Functions
notes.text: For transfer of functions of Federal Surplus Commodities Corporation, see Transfer of Functions note set out under section 712a of this title.
